summary: Derive the web app changelog registry from its directory so adding an entry no longer edits a shared file

replay.detail: Build tooling only; no claim replay or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, schema-version changes or data rewrites.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes; no coordinated member upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: The compiled public changelog manifest and the public bundle are byte-identical before and after.

manual.detail: No operator actions; open branches drop their mod.ts hunk, keep their entry file and merge main.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or swap-back restrictions.
